 Profile Summary

   • Computer Science researcher specializing in computer vision and ML/DL for healthcare
      applications. Focused on marker-less gait analysis for identifying musculoskeletal and neurological
      disorders. Experienced in pose estimation (e.g., BlazePose) and transformer-based models for
     spatiotemporal analysis. Committed to developing non-invasive, scalable solutions for early
      diagnosis and rehabilitation support.

Projects

   • Smart Campus Access Control System (BITS Pilani)

– Design Description: Developed an automated visitor management framework to replace manual paper-based
             logs. The system utilizes a centralized database for real-time entry/exit tracking and a wireless front-end for
            security personnel.
       – Improvement: Replaced traditional manual record-keeping with a digital-first approach, eliminating data
          redundancy and loss. Integrated a wireless QR code scanning interface to facilitate rapid, contactless exit
             validation, significantly reducing processing time and improving data integrity for security auditing.
       – System Features: Real-time MongoDB database logging, automated time-stamping, wireless hand-held
           scanner integration, and an administrative dashboard for security traffic analytics.
       – Currently deployed and live at BITS Pilani, actively used for campus access control and visitor
         management.

  • Remote Home Appliance Control System using Raspberry Pi

       – Design Description: Built a low-cost, open-source home automation system using a Raspberry Pi 2B as a
          Wi-Fi web server to remotely monitor and control household electrical appliances. The system drives a 220V
       AC load (bulb) and a 5V DC motor via relay circuits, and reads live room temperature from a DS18B20 sensor,
               all accessible from any Wi-Fi-capable mobile device.
       – Improvement: Replaced manual, mechanical appliance operation with remote GPIO-based control, reducing
          power consumption and human effort while improving accessibility for elderly and differently-abled users.
          Enabled real-time temperature readout and appliance state tracking through a browser interface reachable from
             inside or outside the home.
       – System Features: Apache and PHP web server on Raspberry Pi, GPIO-driven relay switching (transistor + 1
          kΩdriver) for AC and DC loads, DS18B20 temperature monitoring over the 1-Wire interface, and a
           Bootstrap-based mobile web UI using HTTP POST for on/off control.
